value.question: What are the opening and closing hours of DD House?
value.answer: DD House is open every day from 4:00 PM to 11:00 PM.

value.question: Where is DD House located?
value.answer: DD House is located at Venkat Nagar, Jayendra Nagar, Siddartha Nagar, Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh – 533003.

value.question: Do you offer home delivery?
value.answer: DD House currently supports store pickup rather than delivery. Customer must pick up the order from the store.

value.question: Is parking available at DD House?
value.answer: DD House does not have dedicated parking. Customers can use DMart parking. Note that DMart parking is NOT an official DD House parking facility.

value.question: Can I customize brownies?
value.answer: No, brownies cannot be customized. Only cake bowls can be customized.

value.question: Can I have my name or message written on the cake?
value.answer: Customers can request a name and message, but it is NOT written directly on the cake. The name/message can be written on the BOX.

value.question: What is the cancellation policy?
value.answer: You can cancel within 5 minutes of placing your order for a full refund. After 5 minutes, some amount will be charged and the remaining amount refunded based on preparation status and elapsed time. There is no fixed percentage or fee.

value.question: How long does order preparation take?
value.answer: Normal preparation takes 15 minutes, and up to 20 minutes during heavy rush.
